title: Comprehensive Chemical Analysis of the Methyl 3-Nitrogen-2,3-Dideoxysaccharides Derivatives with d-ribo-Configuration: Synthesis, Reactivity of HIV-1 Reverse Transcriptase Inhibitors.
authors: Dabrowska, Aleksandra M; Kazmierkiewicz, Rajmund; Barabas-Lepak, Anna M; Biedulska, Malgorzata; Chylewska, Agnieszka
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲基3-氮-2,3-二脱氧糖衍生物的合成、理化性质及其与CT-DNA的结合和HIV逆转录酶抑制活性，涉及分子对接但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: This study extends previous research, particularly focusing on patented scientific objects No. ID: PL 240 353 B1, investigating the physicochemical properties of the methyl 3-azido- and 3-amino-2,3-dideoxysaccharides with a nucleoside scaffold similar to 3'-azidothymidine (AZT). The study utilizes multiwavelength spectrophotometric and potentiometric methods to evaluate the ionization of the saccharide units in aqueous solutions. pK(a) values, obtained from two independent methods, reveal significant sugar ionization effects on UV spectra with varying pH levels. Stability constants for divalent metal ion complexes (Cu(2+) and Ni(2+)) with the saccharide isomers indicate that complex stoichiometries and stabilities are highly dependent on the configuration of sugar ring substituents. Spectrophotometric results show a descending order of CT-DNA-binding affinity: BRNH(2)OMe > BRN(3)OMe > ARN(3)OMe > ARNH(2)OMe, suggesting varied interaction strengths. Molecular docking of models of synthesized O-glycosides confirmed their potential as reverse transcriptase inhibitors. Among the derivatives tested, the compound BRN(3)OMe displays the highest interaction with the enzyme active site residues and DNA, suggesting it may possess the greatest efficacy. Our reported results highlight the promising inhibitory properties of novel O-glycosides against HIV reverse transcriptase, supporting their potential development as antiviral agents.
abstract_zh: 本研究在前期研究基础上进一步拓展，特别聚焦于专利科学对象编号ID: PL 240 353 B1，探讨具有与3'-叠氮胸苷（AZT）相似核苷骨架的甲基3-叠氮基-和3-氨基-2,3-二脱氧糖的理化性质。研究采用多波长分光光度法和电位法评估糖单元在水溶液中的电离行为。通过两种独立方法获得的pK(a)值揭示，不同pH水平下糖电离对紫外光谱产生显著影响。二价金属离子（Cu(2+)和Ni(2+)）与糖异构体形成的稳定常数表明，配合物的化学计量比和稳定性高度依赖于糖环取代基的构型。分光光度结果显示CT-DNA结合亲和力呈下降顺序：BRNH(2)OMe > BRN(3)OMe > ARN(3)OMe > ARNH(2)OMe，表明相互作用强度存在差异。对合成的O-糖苷模型进行分子对接，证实其具有作为逆转录酶抑制剂的潜力。在所测试的衍生物中，化合物BRN(3)OMe与酶活性位点残基及DNA的相互作用最强，提示其可能具有最大效力。我们报告的结果凸显了新型O-糖苷对HIV逆转录酶的潜在抑制特性，支持其作为抗病毒药物开发的可行性。
